session.instructions:
An original adult Japanese female voice in her late twenties, speaking native standard Japanese. Icy-cold, aloof, unsmiling low-mid contralto register with dark-crystal clarity and frosty emotional distance. Delivery direction: Trembling breathy sigh, embarrassed awareness of being inside the silent operating room, clear vocal projection. No music or background noise.
